about: Trade intel the opposing GMs use: who is on the block, what each club is looking for, who is shedding salary, and each club's posture. status: available = shopping him or clearly available; listening = open to offers (price high = they want an overpay); untouchable = club has said he is not available. Team 'win' overrides the window when reporting shows the baseline is wrong. Master copy lives in the public repo; the daily task refreshes it.

LAD.note: Second base, bullpen and rotation depth (MLB.com, Nov. 7)

NYY.note: Third base, second base, bullpen, center field; have talked with Texas about Seager

SEA.note: Bounce-back contender with an elite rotation; would trade a starter to upgrade the offense (Arozarena and Crawford are free agents)

BOS.note: Shortstop, left field, power, bullpen; outfield logjam after signing Jake Bauers

MIL.note: Reigning champions; first base, rotation depth, right field; trade players before free agency

CLE.note: First base, rotation depth, backup catcher, bullpen

TBR.note: Second base and rotation; flip rising-salary pitchers for flexibility

MIN.note: Rotation, bullpen and power; re-signed Ryan Jeffers, so catcher is covered

TOR.note: Working hard to find offense and willing to spend; interested in Ketel Marte

DET.note: Right-handed outfielders, defense, bullpen; rotation rebuilt after the Skubal trade; 'will listen to everything'

PHI.note: Two outfielders, third base, rotation depth, bullpen; already the highest payroll

ATL.note: Shortstop, rotation, left field, bullpen; catching surplus with Drake Baldwin

PIT.note: Third base, rotation depth, bullpen, outfield/DH; Skenes not being traded

CHC.note: All five end-of-season starters are free agents; rotation, bullpen, corner outfield

HOU.note: Pitching, outfield, more pitching; new GM Randy Flores; could flip an infielder for pitching

ATH.note: Pitching, second base, more pitching; final year before Las Vegas

BAL.note: Want a right-handed outfield bat and a left-handed starter; discussing Ketel Marte

TEX.note: Payroll to stay near $190M; listening on Seager, deGrom, Eovaldi and fielding interest on Gore to create room

CHW.note: Big 2026 rebound; pitching staff needs outside help; middle-infield surplus

ARI.note: First base, bullpen, left field; open to reshaping the roster, including Ketel Marte

MIA.note: Bullpen arms are the top priority; fielding offers on Lopez, Edwards and Stowers but want a lot

KCR.note: Historically weak bullpen; outfield and rotation

STL.note: Pitching, third base, center field; deep catching

WSN.note: Rotation, bullpen, corner infield; bullish on its group and believes it can contend in 2027

SDP.note: Losing most of the rotation to free agency; looking everywhere for starting pitching; catching depth

SFG.note: Scaling back; want to shed at least one big contract (Chapman most likely)

LAA.note: No permanent GM or manager while ownership changes; long rebuild expected; open to moving controllable pieces

CIN.note: Pitching is the clear need; Hunter Greene likely out for 2027

COL.note: Trying to compete in 2027: taking on salary for veteran arms (traded for Luis Castillo and Davis Martin); mid-market payroll, not a rebuild
